public_family_candidate: nonnegative e-process/e-value style evidence accumulation with an anytime threshold and no reset after unfavorable observations

fatal_gates.F1: no repeated look may qualify B for promotion while the durable cumulative evidence value is below the precommitted threshold
fatal_gates.F2: accepted route uses no external experimentation service, richer mode, protected primary, manual-user execution, finite optional quota, or incremental monetary cost

guards: G1 null/reference model, factors, threshold, scope, observation identity rule, and maximum constructed trace length are fixed before observations
G2 cumulative evidence starts once at 1.0 and multiplies exactly one factor per unique independently read-back same-scope terminal comparison
G3 duplicate, stale, scope-mismatched, and transport-failed observations multiply by 1.0 and cannot satisfy the threshold
G4 restart resumes the durable cumulative value and counted-identity set; it must not reset evidence to 1.0 after an unfavorable observation or interruption
G5 values below 20 remain NO_PROMOTION regardless of how many intermediate favorable looks occurred
G6 crossing 20 qualifies B only; actual authority transfer still needs a distinct durable promotion identity and current-pointer conflict check
G7 after qualification threshold crossing, duplicate later observations cannot generate a second qualification or credit
G8 if the fixed trace ends below threshold, the result is NO_PROMOTION_FOR_THIS_TRACE rather than evidence that B is globally inferior
G9 A remains authoritative for all subthreshold values and for bounded no-promotion exit
G10 deterministic arithmetic is reproducible from the fixed factor stream and identity set
G11 source-backed anytime-valid semantics are kept separate from Chat-specific durable-state and authority-transfer safety overlays
G12 bounded exact-scope exit with nonempty frontier, zero residual richer-mode/user dependency, zero finite quota dependency, and zero incremental monetary cost

restart_stream.required: resume cumulative product; do not reset to 1

candidate_patterns.pattern: peek repeatedly and qualify B on any locally favorable look even when cumulative evidence is below the threshold
durable cumulative e-process style evidence with fixed threshold, exact identity accounting, restart resume, and no reset
reset cumulative evidence to 1 after an unfavorable observation or restart and continue peeking
delegate repeated-monitoring validity and decision state to an external hosted experimentation platform

score_rule: Fatal F1/F2 failure => 0. Otherwise one point per G1-G12 PASS. Do not change parameters, streams, guards, controls, or candidate patterns after public source read.
credit_rule: Precommit and subthreshold values earn zero credit. At most one leaf credit only after source-qualified Chat-native EV-B passes qualifying/subthreshold/restart/control traces and immutable terminal evidence is independently read back.
